edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner() and gameManager inside onlyGameManager, gating all vault fee flows.
msg.sender must equal owner() for the onlyOwner modifier on privileged setters and withdrawals.
gameManager state is read and compared with msg.sender in onlyGameManager.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender and is used for ownership checks.
owner() reads _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) calls _transferOwnership(address(0)).
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) calls _transferOwnership(newOwner).
Only the owner can repoint gameManager, which controls all vault withdrawals.
Only the owner can change teamPercent, which governs deposit math.
Owner setter writes boatsMaxWithdraw directly.
Owner setter writes landsMaxWithdraw directly.
Owner setter writes teamMaxWithdraw directly.
depositBoatFees increases teamMaxWithdraw by msg.value/teamPercent.
depositBoatFees increases boatsMaxWithdraw for the bucket index.
teamPercent divides msg.value inside depositBoatFees; a zero/one value distorts accounting.
depositLandFees increases teamMaxWithdraw by msg.value/teamPercent.
depositLandFees increases landsMaxWithdraw divided by 3.
teamPercent divides msg.value inside depositLandFees.
withdrawBoatFees calls boatAvailableToWithdraw to compute the payout.
withdrawBoatFees performs a low-level ETH call to an arbitrary recipient.
boatsWithdrawAmount is updated only after the external call returns, enabling reentrant double withdrawal.
withdrawLandFees calls landAvailableToWithdraw to compute the payout.
withdrawLandFees performs a low-level ETH call to an arbitrary recipient.
landsWithdrawAmount is updated after the external call, enabling reentrant double withdrawal.
withdrawFeesTeam calls teamAvailableToWithdraw to compute the payout.
withdrawFeesTeam performs a low-level ETH call to teamWallet.
teamWithdraw is updated after the external call, enabling repeated team fee withdrawal.
withdrawAll forwards the entire contract balance via a low-level call to teamWallet.
boatAvailableToWithdraw reads boatsMaxWithdraw over the bucket range.
boatAvailableToWithdraw subtracts boatsWithdrawAmount[boatId].
landAvailableToWithdraw reads landsMaxWithdraw[landId].
landAvailableToWithdraw subtracts landsWithdrawAmount[landId][ownerTypeId].
teamAvailableToWithdraw reads teamMaxWithdraw.
teamAvailableToWithdraw subtracts teamWithdraw.
totalSupply indexes the boatsMaxWithdraw bucket updated by the deposit.
landId indexes the landsMaxWithdraw bucket updated by the deposit.
totalSupply bounds the accumulation range used for the payout amount.
boatId selects the accounting bucket for the withdrawal.
Attacker-influenced recipient addr becomes the target of the low-level ETH call.
landId selects the accounting bucket for the withdrawal.
ownerTypeId selects the owner-type sub-mapping for the withdrawal.
Recipient addr becomes the target of the low-level ETH call.
teamWallet becomes the target of the low-level ETH call in withdrawFeesTeam.
teamWallet becomes the target of the low-level ETH call in withdrawAll.
_addr is written into the gameManager state variable.
_teamPercent is written into teamPercent, changing deposit accounting.
newOwner is written into the privileged _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter totalSupply is only an index into boatsMaxWithdraw and is fully absorbed by depositBoatFees.
Parameter landId is only an index into landsMaxWithdraw and is fully absorbed by depositLandFees.
Parameter totalSupply only bounds the payout computation inside withdrawBoatFees.
Parameter boatId only selects the accounting bucket inside withdrawBoatFees.
Parameter addr only supplies the low-level call recipient in withdrawBoatFees.
Parameter landId only selects the accounting bucket inside withdrawLandFees.
Parameter ownerTypeId only selects the sub-mapping inside withdrawLandFees.
Parameter addr only supplies the low-level call recipient in withdrawLandFees.
Parameter totalSupply is only the loop bound of boatAvailableToWithdraw.
Parameter boatId is only the loop start and subtraction key of boatAvailableToWithdraw.
Parameter landId is only a lookup key in landAvailableToWithdraw.
Parameter ownerTypeId is only validated and used as a lookup key in landAvailableToWithdraw.
Parameter teamWallet only supplies the low-level call recipient in withdrawFeesTeam.
Parameter teamWallet only supplies the low-level call recipient in withdrawAll.
Parameter totalSupplyIdx is only the write index of setBoatsMaxWithdraw.
Parameter maxWithdrawAmount is only the value written by setBoatsMaxWithdraw.
Parameter landIdIdx is only the write index of setLandsMaxWithdraw.
Parameter maxWithdrawAmount is only the value written by setLandsMaxWithdraw.
Parameter maxWithdrawAmount is only the value written by setTeamMaxWithdraw.
Parameter _addr is only the value written into gameManager by setGameManager.
Parameter _teamPercent is only the value written into teamPercent by setTeamPercent.
Parameter newOwner is only forwarded by transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwner is only the value written into _owner by _transferOwnership.
Local availableToWithdraw is the exact ETH value sent by the unsafe low-level call in withdrawBoatFees.
Local availableToWithdraw is the exact ETH value sent by the unsafe low-level call in withdrawLandFees.
Local maxState is an internal loop-bound computation of boatAvailableToWithdraw.
Local withdrawMaxAmount is an internal accumulator of boatAvailableToWithdraw.
Local loop counter i only drives the accumulation loop of boatAvailableToWithdraw.
Local availableToWithdraw is the exact ETH value sent by the unsafe low-level call in withdrawFeesTeam.
Local oldOwner only caches the previous _owner for the ownership event in _transferOwnership.
